semantics.reset: Active-high asynchronous reset triggered by posedge areset; reset has priority at clock edges while asserted and sets state to 2'b01.
semantics.training: At posedge clk with areset low, train_valid=1 increments if train_taken=1 or decrements if train_taken=0; train_valid=0 holds state.
semantics.output: state is the stored counter, updated after the triggering edge with no additional pipeline stages.
semantics.initialization: No power-up initialization specified; verify only after reset.
semantics.between_edges: Training input changes and falling clock edges do not update state; reset deassertion alone does not update state.

numeric.encoding: Unsigned two-bit binary counter, range 0 through 3.

verification.oracle: Independent integer reference applying clamped addition/subtraction on each positive clock edge and reset to 1 on asynchronous assertion.
coverage: All four starting states with all four combinations of training inputs
Disabled training holds for either direction
Reset away from a clock edge
Reset priority over training and held reset through clock edges
Reset deassertion and falling edges preserve state
verification.checks: Self-checking independent development testbench, explicit dev_tb top, Icarus -g2012, finite compile and simulation timeouts; static source review.
